name: Новий концепт за референсами
description: Create an original full-body character from a brief and 1–4 existing style references. SDXL + IP-Adapter. Variants are stochastic; separate briefs are needed for separate design directions.
limitations: Experimental baseline; no guaranteed style match or consistent multiple views.

name: Редагування за строгою маскою
description: Replace a region of an existing concept using an instruction, source image and separate grayscale PNG mask. White edits, black preserves. No automatic mask creation. References help the agent write the prompt; this image workflow conditions on source and mask only. Final source-resolution compositing is performed by the application.
limitations: SDXL base latent inpainting baseline; large changes and faces may require more iterations. No unmasked edits.
